summary:
Iteration 12 — Frontend-only validation of the 'Mapa del día' rich interactive map feature across all 3 tiers (landmarks/waypoints/stay) on multiple programs at desktop (1920x4000) and mobile (390x844) viewports. CORE FEATURE WORKS: Tier 1 (landmarks), Tier 2 (waypoints) and Tier 3 (stay) all open the LandmarkCarousel drawer with 3 image cards. All Unsplash images load (img.complete=true, naturalWidth=1200). Drawer toggle close works. Leaflet CircleMarker click (via Playwright locator) opens the drawer. Mobile carousel is horizontally scrollable (scrollWidth=985, clientWidth=340, overflow-x:auto) and mobile prev/next buttons present and clickable. 0 console errors, 0 pageerror across all tests.

PROGRAMS TESTED:
• /viajes/gransur/tanger-rak/programa_8n_9d — 9 maps (T1=1, T2=6, T3=2). Tier 2 routes trk89-tanger-chefchaouen, trk89-volubilis-meknes-fez, frz910-todra-dades all open drawers with 3 loaded images. Tier 3 trk89-fez-discover + frz67-marrakech-medina-return open drawers correctly. Tier 1 desert-bivouac retained all 6 day-landmark-btn-desert-bivouac-* buttons (no regression).
• /viajes/norte/tanger_fez/programa_4n_5d — 5 maps (T2=3, T3=2). tf45-tanger-tetuan waypoint 0 click → 3 loaded cards. Marker click via SVG circle path also opened drawer with 3 loaded images.
• /viajes/escapadas/marrakech/programa_2n_3d — 3 maps all Tier 3 (escrak-arrival, escrak-medina, escrak23-return). NONE expose a day-stay-btn-* clickable (count=0 for all). StayInteractive did not upgrade these to interactive even though Marrakech is canonical.

LANGUAGE:
• EN via direct URL /en/tours/grand-south/tangier-marrakech/program-8n-9d works perfectly: 9 maps, drawer text translates to English ('White ramparts and square rooftops over the Atlantic blue…').
• FR via direct URL /fr/tours/grand-south/tangier-marrakech/program-8n-9d 404-redirects to homepage.
• FR pill (bottom-left, ES|EN|FR) is a <button> with onClick that does NOT navigate and does NOT switch drawer language — clicking it keeps URL+drawer in Spanish.

MOBILE: tanger-rak 8n_9d at 390×844: 3 cards rendered, overflow-x scroll works, landmark-carousel-prev-mobile-* / next-mobile-* both render and are clickable. Screenshot confirms responsive layout.

ui_bugs.issue: escapadas/marrakech/programa_2n_3d Tier 3 stays (escrak-arrival, escrak-medina, escrak23-return) do NOT render a clickable day-stay-btn-{routeId}. StayInteractive likely failed to resolve a CITY_PROFILES entry for these tokens (escrak-medina anchors Marrakech which IS canonical, so this is a regression vs. acceptance criterion).

FR pill is a <button onclick=…> that DOES NOT change URL or drawer language when clicked. After click URL stays at /viajes/… and drawer renders Spanish text. EN pill likely affected by same wiring (not separately validated but same DOM structure: href=null). User cannot reach FR/EN content via the pill — only via direct URL works (and only for EN; FR localized routes also missing).

/fr/tours/grand-south/tangier-marrakech/program-8n-9d returns the homepage (no FR program-detail route registered). EN equivalent /en/tours/… works fine. FR translation copy IS in cityProfiles.js so this is purely a routing gap.

action_items: Investigate why escapadas-marrakech tokens (escrak-arrival/escrak-medina/escrak23-return) fail to upgrade to clickable Tier-3 StayInteractive. Likely the resolver tokenToProfileKey / COORD_TO_PROFILE does not map these anchors to the marrakech profile. Add explicit mapping or alias.
Wire the FR (and EN) language pill button to actually navigate to /fr or /en routes (or to toggle a global locale state that the page consumes). Currently the onClick is a no-op for content.
Register the /fr/tours/* program-detail routes (or whatever the FR slug scheme should be) — currently FR URLs 404 to homepage even though FR copy is authored in cityProfiles.js.

(Minor) Suggested verification: the '/viajes/sur/atlas_desierto/programa_4n_5d' URL listed in the review brief also 404-redirected to homepage during testing. If this path was renamed, the review brief should be updated; otherwise Tier-1 regression for atlas_desierto could not be exercised on that URL (Tier-1 desert-bivouac WAS regression-verified on tanger-rak/8n_9d instead, which passed).
critical_code_review_comments: StayInteractive (DayRouteMap.jsx, Tier 3) should log/warn when an anchor coordinate cannot be matched to a CITY_PROFILES entry so missed-mapping bugs surface early instead of silently degrading to non-clickable StayCard.

LandmarkCarousel.jsx — when landmark.gallery has more than 3 items (observed Marrakech-return drawer rendered 6 cards because Tier-3 leaves drawer open between clicks), the '3 CARDS' counter label in the header becomes inaccurate. Consider hard-capping to 3 OR adapting the counter dynamically.

The drawer 'open' state appears to be NOT scoped per-map: clicking waypoints across different DayRouteMap instances stacks open drawers on the page (verified — after opening Tier 2 of one route and Tier 3 of another, both drawers remained visible). Toggle close works only for the same waypoint. Decide if multi-drawer-open is intentional or if opening one should auto-close others.

LanguageSwitcher button uses onClick without navigation — there should be a clear, single source of truth for locale (URL prefix vs. state). Mixed approach (URL works for /en but pill toggles state) creates the regression observed.

success_rate.frontend: 85% — Tier 1/2/3 drawers + images + marker click + mobile carousel + EN URL all PASS; escapadas-marrakech stays not clickable, FR pill broken, FR URL 404 are the 3 failures

context_for_next_testing_agent: Acceptance criteria verified on /viajes/gransur/tanger-rak/programa_8n_9d (all 9 day maps), /viajes/norte/tanger_fez/programa_4n_5d (5 day maps), /viajes/escapadas/marrakech/programa_2n_3d (3 day maps – stays not clickable), /en/tours/grand-south/tangier-marrakech/program-8n-9d (EN works). Tests: drawer open via day-waypoint-btn-{routeId}-{idx}, drawer open via day-stay-btn-{routeId}, Leaflet CircleMarker click via path.leaflet-interactive (sort SVG paths by 'd' attribute length — circles are short ~41 chars, polylines are longer; index 2-3 are the markers on a 2-waypoint map). Mobile testids landmark-carousel-prev-mobile-{id} and -next-mobile-{id} render at 390×844. Images load reliably from images.unsplash.com (HTTP 200, naturalWidth=1200). 0 console errors throughout. The FR-pill is a <button> with no href and a no-op onClick — verify by clicking and inspecting page.url + drawer text.
rca of the issue: 1) escapadas-marrakech stays: the routeId tokens 'escrak-arrival', 'escrak-medina', 'escrak23-return' likely do not match any key in tokenToProfileKey, and the anchor coord lookup in COORD_TO_PROFILE may not include the exact lat/lng used for these escrak routes. Add explicit alias or coord registration for the Marrakech anchor used by these routes. 2) FR pill: the LanguageSwitcher component's onClick is not invoking router.push to /fr/* nor a context setter that downstream components consume. 3) FR localized route: app routes only register /en/* alongside /viajes/* (Spanish default), but /fr/* is unregistered → catch-all serves the home page.
